description: This Java class defines the data structure for share accounts within the Fineract project, including account details, status, timeline, charges, dividends, and associated entities like product options and client accounts.

classes.name: ShareAccountData
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) representing share account information, including account identifiers, status, timeline, charges, dividends, associated products, and client accounts.

methods.name: importInstance
methods.description: Creates a new ShareAccountData instance for import purposes with specified attributes.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a dummy ShareAccountData object with provided options, mainly for templating forms.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Provides a static method to generate a minimal ShareAccountData instance with basic identifiers.
